0.0.4.description:
The first public release for the Y2ROLL Archipelago implementation (as well as some other Y2ROLL mods).

- Archipelago mod (0.0.4)
    - Gem, Gold Medal, Level Clear Checks
    - World/Level unlock modes
    - On/Off/YAML settings per trap and DeathLink/TrapLink
    - DeathLink
    - TrapLink
- Mod Menu (1.0.0)
- Custom Player Skins (1.0.0)
   - Color/Image/Invisible options

`Y2ROLL-mods.zip` includes each mod and the patcher for those who don't want to clone the git repo.
0.0.4.title: Y2ROLL 0.0.4
